name: nexa-workspace
description: Workspace raíz de los paquetes TypeScript de Nexa (lo que corre en el navegador). El compilador/toolchain vive en crates/ (Rust), fuera de este workspace.

scripts.build:cli-assets: esbuild packages/runtime/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-runtime.js && esbuild packages/router/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-router.js && esbuild packages/forms/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-forms.js && esbuild packages/dev-client/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-dev-client.js && esbuild packages/platform/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-platform.js && esbuild packages/devtools/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-devtools.js && esbuild packages/telemetry/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-telemetry.js && esbuild packages/islands/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-islands.js && esbuild packages/ui/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-ui.js && esbuild packages/app/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=crates/nexa-cli/assets/nexa-app.js
